reader.requirement: Every item whose usage is DISPLAY, written explicitly at the item or a group or implied, is held in the standard character format, one character position per byte with no slack, aligned on a character boundary, for every DISPLAY category 1985 has (alphabetic, alphanumeric, numeric with or without S and SIGN, numeric edited); the witness covers only an unsigned numeric and an alphanumeric item at elementary and group level.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses the post-1985 usages (NATIONAL, BINARY-LONG family, POINTER etc.) below their introducing edition; DISPLAY has no row

reader.edition-search: grep of CobolVersion|EditionContext|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior in DataItem.cs, PicInfo.cs and UsageInheritancePass.cs found none; the DISPLAY width arm (ElementaryImageWidth, 1 byte per position) is edition-free.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: signed DISPLAY (trailing overpunch, SIGN LEADING SEPARATE), numeric edited, alphabetic, SYNC on a DISPLAY item and ODO tables of DISPLAY items are not exercised

probes.printed: V1=Q12C  1.50AB42-07| (X, S9(3) overpunch, ZZ9.99, A(2), 9(2) SYNC, S9(2) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE: 17 bytes, no slack); V4=12XY9|; N1=12|C| (ref-mod at both bounds); Z=+000|; M=+999|
probes.expected: standard data format, character boundary: each position one character, no alignment slack, a SYNC DISPLAY item not padded

probes.printed: R5=123| then after MOVE 5 TO CNT R5=12345|
probes.expected: ODO table of DISPLAY digits occupies one character per occurrence

probes.printed: COBOL0900 national data requires COBOL-2002 (N1, N2); COBOL0900 fixed-width binary usage requires COBOL-2002 (B3); DISPLAY-1 a syntax error

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.14.4 GR5  (5.14.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: The DISPLAY representation is one byte per character position, measured through REDEFINES views and reference modification at 85; SYNCHRONIZED on a DISPLAY item adds no slack, consistent with the character-boundary sentence. Nothing on the path reads the edition; the only edition reads refuse later usages.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-105/src/g5a.cob at --std 85 (g5a-001): forms the reader did not try, 99PPP (P positions take no storage), SVPP99 SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE, S99 SIGN LEADING overpunch, alphanumeric edited XBX0X/, $$9.99CR, S9(2) SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE SYNCHRONIZED, 9(18). It printed LG=0042, which is 2+3+2+6+8+3+18 with no slack. The REDEFINES image was [1212-M5A B0C/ $3.50CR07+999999999999999999  ], one character per position, the leading overpunch M for -4 and the SYNC item unpadded. Grep of CobolVersion|EditionContext|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry in Binding/Model DataItem.cs and PicInfo.cs found only a comment, so the edition-free arm is the one 85 takes. cite.py: OK  §1985:VI.5.14.4 GR5  (5.14.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5.
